nodes.corka.options.[amulet].text.t: Amulet of a fallen comrade. Hers.

nodes.corka.options.[oddaj].text.t: It fits the door in the ruins. It's yours.

nodes.corka.text.t: A young woman sits on a step, worrying a leather thong with an empty loop. "My father was a guard at the ruins. Wore a token like yours, only a real one." She fixes her eyes on your chest. "Where'd you get it, stranger?"

nodes.oddany.text.t: She takes the amulet in both hands, like a newborn. "God repay you. Nobody's ever given me anything back without haggling. Father wouldn't have believed his eyes. My mother lives in Głuszec, past the graveyard. If you're going that way, look in on her."

nodes.opowiesc.text.t: "Father used to say there's a door in the ruins that only a token like that opens. He looked for it till the day he died and never found it. The ruins are a day's walk south. Go there, hold it to the wall and come back and tell me if it fits. If it does, the old man was right. And that's more than he ever told me while he lived."

nodes.po_oddany.text.t: The girl turns the token in her fingers and smiles for the first time. "I've lost count of how often I look at it. Hung it over my bed, against the night-hag. Father would call that foolishness, but Father never looked at it this long."

nodes.po_zatrzymany.text.t: The girl looks away. "I'm not holding it against you. A keepsake's a keepsake. But if it ever starts to weigh on you, you know where I live."

nodes.zatrzymany.text.t: She presses her lips together. "Have it your way. A keepsake's a keepsake. Just mind nobody tears it off you, hand and all." She goes back to her thong. "My mother lives in Głuszec, past the graveyard. If you're going that way, look in on her."
